newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan March trade deficit rises to $304 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan March trade deficit rises to $304 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit rose to a provisional $304 million in March from $204 million in February, but fell compared to $313 million in March 1996, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
Exports increased 22.3 percent to a provisional $785 million in March from $642 million in February, but decreased by 9.9 percent compared to $871 million in March 1996.
Imports increased 28.7 percent to $1.089 billion in March from $846 million in February but decreased by 8.0 percent compared to $1.184 billion in March 1996.

The trade gap fell to a provisional $2.624 billion in the July-March of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) from $2.674 billion in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery, chemicals, wheat and petroleum products. -- Tahir Ikram 9251-274757
